### Observation 1 — Codeball: AI-powered PR review classifier

**File:** [`.github/workflows/codeball.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/blob/.github/workflows/codeball.yml)

Codeball (by `sturdy-dev`) is an ML-based service that classifies pull requests as "approved" or "needs review". The workflow is triggered on every `pull_request` and `pull_request_review_comment` event. Key configuration:

```yaml
uses: sturdy-dev/codeball-action@v2
with:
  approvePullRequests: "false"         # does NOT auto-approve
  labelPullRequestsWhenApproved: "true"
  labelPullRequestsWhenReviewNeeded: "true"
  failJobsWhenReviewNeeded: "false"
```

- **Invocation**: Automatic on every PR open/update.
- **Constraint**: Auto-approval is explicitly disabled (`approvePullRequests: "false"`). The agent only applies labels; human approval is still required.
- **Disclosure**: The action is named "Codeball" in the workflow but there is no disclosure to PR authors that their code is being scored by an ML model.
- **Bot identity**: `sturdy-dev/codeball-action` — a third-party GitHub App/Action with a documented ML backend.

---

### Observation 2 — Issues Similarity Analysis: NLP-based duplicate detection

**File:** [`.github/workflows/issues-similarity-analysis.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/blob/.github/workflows/issues-similarity-analysis.yml)

Uses `actions-cool/issues-similarity-analysis@v1` to compare newly opened/edited issues against the existing issue corpus and post a comment with semantically similar issues.

```yaml
uses: actions-cool/issues-similarity-analysis@v1
with:
  filter-threshold: 0.5
  comment-title: '### You may look for issues:'
  comment-body: '${index}. ${similarity} #${number}'
```

- **Invocation**: Automatic on `issues: [opened, edited]`.
- **Constraint**: Threshold of `0.5` (50% similarity) gates which matches are surfaced.
- **Disclosure**: Comment posted to the issue author shows matched issue numbers and similarity scores. The comment does not identify itself as bot-generated.
- **Bot identity**: `actions-cool/issues-similarity-analysis` — implies NLP/vector-similarity computation; the score field in the comment body (`${similarity}`) is a floating-point similarity coefficient.

---

- [`.github/workflows/issue-close-require.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/blob/.github/workflows/issue-close-require.yml)
- [`.github/workflows/issue-remove-inactive.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/blob/.github/workflows/issue-remove-inactive.yml)

- [`.github/workflows/pr-check-ci.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/blob/.github/workflows/pr-check-ci.yml)

**File:** [`.github/workflows/verify-files-modify.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/blob/.github/workflows/verify-files-modify.yml)

**Files:**
- [`.github/dependabot.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/ant-design-ant-design@2f623fe5536395bbb4dfa694fae6dbf2042d9025/-/blob/.github/dependabot.yml)
